reviews.text: Looks like a potentially great replacement for Wave Receipts (appears to use the same OCR engine). But unfortunately, certainly for users in Australia, it has a major showstopping flaw. In AU the sales tax (GST) amount has to be shown separately on a receipt, but the receipt total already includes the tax. This app is adding the sales tax onto the total again, so the scanned receipt amounts are all incorrect as the tax has effectively been added twice! Cannot see an option to switch off adding sales tax to the total. Manually correcting every scanned receipt is a total showstopper. Suggest you look at adding a setting option to switch off auto adding tax.

reviews.text: Amazing app easy to use 👍☺️
Super user friendly and fast!

Great app! I needed something to organize my receipt sprawl for multiple purposes: personal business, income tax, etc. and Foreceipt does just this. The OCR function is surprisingly accurate, it even read half of a crumpled up receipt. In these situations where it's not accurate, it's a cinch to manually update. I plan to expand usage to check (multiple) credit card bills too. A couple of cons, the information is stored on their servers, so as far as tax documentation goes, I can't guarantee that Foreceipt will hold my receipts for the required 7+ years I need them kept for. I also had an incident during the first couple of days of installation: yes, emailing the receipts worked, however, they don't appear properly (for me) in the app. I emailed about 5 Home Depot receipts, one after the other, and all 5 show the same 1 receipt in the app. The amounts are correct, and the web interface shows the correct receipt, just the app is messed up. Also, these receipts are PDF, and the zoom-in feature available to photographed receipts doesn't work on the web. In other words, for these emailed PDFs - there is no way for me to read the receipt other than going back to the original-original receipt. The work-around is to photograph them (yes, you can photograph the screen - it works!), but still, it's a feature they advertise that should work as promised. Feature request would be to build some summary information into the search feature. The reports are a bit cumbersome as noted by other reviewers, and for the credit-card checking use-case, probably simpler to use than to generate a report. I am also not a fan of the subscription model, but would rather pay one-time for a superior version.
